safety.title: Safety Information
safety.intro: Please handle fireworks responsibly. Follow local regulations and manufacturer instructions at all times.
safety.point1: Light fireworks only in open, well-ventilated outdoor spaces, away from dry grass and flammable material.
safety.point2: Keep a bucket of water or sand nearby at all times.
safety.point3: Adults should supervise children at all times; children should not light fireworks unsupervised.
safety.point4: Never attempt to relight a "dud" firework — wait and douse it with water.
safety.point5: Store fireworks in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and open flames.
safety.point6: Follow all local and national regulations regarding permitted timings and locations for bursting crackers.
safety.disclaimer: This is general safety guidance only. Final, legally reviewed safety content should be supplied or approved by the client.
